verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents no built-in AI assistant of its own. Its agent features all hand work to external tools. The issue/PR button passes tasks to third-party coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. The MCP server and WebMCP expose GitCafe's tools to outside AI clients and browser agents, and agent skills extend the user's own coding assistant. These are adjacent integrations, not an in-product assistant you can delegate to.
